    """LayerNorm with three fixed scales and seven fixed bias coordinates."""

        super().__init__()
        self.normalized_shape = (d_model,)
        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(d_model - 3))
        self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(d_model - 7))
